title: feat(spec,ui)!: retire the record page's slots.tabs; a page that needs its own strip is kind: 'full'
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBMVTpWL3WoqLD4tN69q1BPz)_

Fixes #27053

## What changes

The record page's `slots.tabs` is retired under the `spec-property-retirement` kit. A slotted page now fills six slots (`header`, `actions`, `alerts`, `highlights`, `details`, `discussion`); a page that needs its own tab strip is `kind: 'full'`.

**Spec (`@objectstack/spec`)**
- `slots.tabs` is a `retiredKey()` tombstone carrying the card's prescription: the record page composes its tabs and columns from the object's roles and relationship flags; set `relatedList` / `relatedList: 'primary'` on the child's reference field to change which related lists appear or their order; author `slots.details` to replace the Details body; a page that needs its own strip is `kind: 'full'`. It ends with the house `os migrate meta --from 17` sentence and carries no issue ids.
- The `related` / `relatedLists` aliases leave with the slot. They are now `guidance` entries that refuse by name with the same remedy, instead of being read as `tabs`.
- `checkPageSlotPair` (the `details` + `tabs` refusal) and `page-slot-pair.test.ts` are removed, and so is its `@objectstack/spec/ui` export. The check-exports pin now asserts that it has zero declarations and zero attachments.
- ADR-0087 D2: the `page-slots-tabs-removed` conversion (`retiredFromLoadPath`, `retiredAfter: '18.2.0'`, order 78) drops `slots.tabs` from a stored page. When `tabs` was the only slot, the page is left as an empty slotted page, which renders the synthesized default.
- ADR-0087 D3: the `page-slots-tabs-retired` entry covers the judgement the conversion cannot make, which is whether such a page should become `kind: 'full'`. It absorbs `page-slots-details-beside-tabs-refused`, because the pair no longer exists. The `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment moves with it (order 112). The retired-key entry is `ui/Page:slots.tabs`.
- The JOIN row in `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`, the liveness `slots` note, and the regenerated api-surface, export-origins and references.

**The four in-repo producers, rebuilt as `kind: 'full'`.** Each rebuild is faithful: the same nodes in the order the synthesizer drew them (header, then the actions/alerts slot, highlights, the strip, then discussion). Nothing is redesigned. Header actions are the object's `record_header` / `record_more` actions in declaration order, which is exactly what the synthesized header drew; the host still appends Edit/Share/Delete.

| Page | Package | Body |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `sys_organization_detail` | `@objectstack/platform-objects` | `page:header` (4 actions) · `record:highlights` (`slug`) · Members / Invitations / Teams strip (unchanged) · `record:discussion` |
| `sys_user_detail` | `@objectstack/platform-objects` | `page:header` (11 actions) · the `record:alert` from its `alerts` slot · highlights · its curated strip · no discussion (its `discussion: []`) |
| `sys_approval_request_detail` | `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` | `page:header` · `record:approval_decision` · highlights · Details / Timeline strip · no discussion (its `discussion: []`) |
| `showcase_project_detail` | `examples/app-showcase` (private) | `page:header` · highlights · Details / Tasks grid / Related strip · `record:discussion` |

**Console (`@object-ui/*`)**
- `buildDefaultPageSchema` composes from the six slots only, and its tabs branch is removed.
- `RecordDetailView`'s `pageColumnsEligible` drops the `slots.tabs` arm, so the one gate line is now `!assignedPage && !namedPageBlocked`.
- `@object-ui/types` removes both `.superRefine(checkPageSlotPair)` attachments and types `PageSlotMap.tabs` as `never`.
- The Studio slot canvas (`SLOT_ORDER`) lists six slots.

**Docs**
- `ui/content/docs/guide/slotted-pages.md`: the slot menu no longer has `tabs`, and the guide says how to shape the strip instead.
- `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` (merged from main during this branch): the same change.
- The generated references.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md`: one bullet. It is paid for by a deletion in the same file (−23 tokens net).

**ADR-0133 and QA**
- ADR-0133's open-question correction gains the inline one-line amendment: the mechanism moves from slotted to full, and the strip does not.
- The `identity-auth.json` source pin moves with it (revision 6).
- `studio-authoring.json` follows the retired pair: the step now PUTs `slots.tabs`, which is refused with `invalid_type`. The pin file, the source anchor and revision 4 are updated to match.

## Why

An authored `tabs` slot replaced the whole synthesized strip. A page that used it lost every related list, approval, attachment and history entry the platform composes from the object, and stayed a tab strip at every width instead of taking the record page's columns. The maintainer ruled the slot out on epic #26676; the card carries that ruling.

## Acceptance notes

- **Correction to the card's premise.** The card assumed no producer used `slots.tabs` ("HotCRM never uses tabs"). Re-measured on main at `0f1045bc`, four in-repo pages authored it: the table above. Seat 1 confirmed moving all four to `kind: 'full'` with identical behaviour.
  - HotCRM's own account page could not be measured from this session: the hotcrm repo is outside this session's scope. If it authors no `tabs`, it parses unchanged. If it does, its stored row is converted on read by the D2 conversion, and its source is listed by `os migrate meta --from 17`.
- **The tombstone.** `safeParse` of `tabs` / `related` / `relatedLists` fails with the prescription, and the six live slots parse. `page-slots-tabs-retirement.test.ts` has 18 cases:
  - tombstone refusal for one component, an array and empty;
  - the alias guidance;
  - the six live slots;
  - a full page with `page:tabs` parses;
  - no `#` and the migrate sentence;
  - `@ts-expect-error` on `definePage`;
  - the barrel no longer exports `checkPageSlotPair`.
- **Stored rows.** A stored slotted page with `tabs` replays through the conversion: `applyConversionsToStoredItem('page', …)`, the tabs-only page becomes `slots: {}`, the conversion is idempotent, and it is retired from the load path. The registry fixture has three pages and expects two notices.
- **Absence pin.** A tree-scoped absence pin (`packages`, `examples`, `skills`, `content`, `scripts`) refuses a `slots` frame holding `tabs`, `related` or `relatedLists` in `.ts`, `.json`, `.yaml` and `.md` fences. It excludes the conversion fixtures, the json-schema output, release notes and changelogs.
- **Fixtures and tests moved.** Each one now uses a live slot (`details`) or reads the full page's region:
  - **spec:** `i18n-resolver.test.ts` (two fixtures), `page-component-filter-record-to-rule-array.test.ts`, `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts`, `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts` (new JOIN row). `page-slot-pair.test.ts` is deleted.
  - **lint:** `page-walk`, `validate-page-field-bindings`, `validate-visibility-predicates` and `page-envelope-audit` tests.
  - **cli:** `i18n-section-coverage` (its fixture is now a `kind: 'full'` page whose region authors its own `page:tabs`, keeping the nesting under test), `platform-page-i18n-parity` (the boundary pin now expects `kind: 'full'`, no `slots`, every component reached, and none addressed).
  - **platform-objects:** `sys-user-details-tab`, `sys-user-security-tab-own-record`, `sys-user-two-factor-display`, `setup-nav-per-user-stores` and `canonical-expression-envelopes` (the control's path is now `regions[0].components[N].visibleWhen`); new `record-page-header-actions.test.ts` (round 2, review should-fix ④.1: for `sys_organization_detail` and `sys_user_detail`, the `page:header` action ids equal the object's `record_header` ∪ `record_more` declarations in declaration order, with a non-vacuous guard); comments in `invite-entry-toolbar.test.ts` and `sys-member.object.ts`.
  - **plugin-approvals:** `sys-approval-request-page.test.ts`, which pins the page body in order.
  - **app-showcase:** comments in `task-detail.page.ts` and `record-action-location-hosts.test.ts`.
  - **ui:** `buildDefaultPageSchema.test.ts` (a stray `tabs` key is ignored and `details` applies), `recordPageColumns.test.ts`, `slots-canvas.test.ts`, `PagePreview.test.tsx`, `spec-object-refinements-7715.test.ts` (the retired slot is refused at both objectui doors), `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts`, and the ten console served-approvals-page copies (`approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPage*.test.tsx`, `ApprovalsInboxPage.opensServedPage-12484.test.tsx`), which now copy the full page whole.

## Verification

Head `ca5556e06`, with main merged at `b322b5da` (11 commits, no conflicts). Runs below are local, under `os-verify-lock`.

- **spec:** `--project local` has 22219 passed. The 3 reds from the first run were fixed and their files re-run green (166 passed): a conversion fixture moved to `details`, the new JOIN row, and the export-origins regeneration. `test:repo` has 82 files / 1343 passed, including the tree-scoped absence pin, which is now listed in `vitest.repo-tests.json`.
- **Package suites:**
  - platform-objects: 96 files / 1377 passed.
  - plugin-approvals: 105 files / 1331 passed.
  - lint: 7522 passed.
  - cli: the three touched files, 59 passed.
  - plugin-auth: `organization-record-page-option`, 3 passed.
- **ui:**
  - `plugin-detail`: 2941 passed.
  - Every ui test that authors a slot map or the served approvals page (19 files): 319 passed.
  - `RecordDetailView` record-page tiers and named-page tests: 13 passed.
  - `PagePreview`: 8 passed.
- **Typecheck:** `turbo run typecheck` over spec, platform-objects, plugin-approvals, lint, cli, example-showcase, `@object-ui/types`, `plugin-detail`, `app-shell` and console: 104 of 104 tasks pass. This includes the test-layer typecheck ledgers.
- **Derived gates:** `dispatch-gates --commands` lists 126 commands, and 121 exit 0. Of the other five:
  - `check:role-word` and `check:cross-package-test-inputs` were real findings. Both were fixed and now exit 0.
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exited 3 because the clone is shallow. After fetching its pinned fixture commit it passes all 48 cases.
  - `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 because they need a full repo build. That is a prerequisite miss, and nothing was measured.
- **Spec artifacts:** `check:generated --fix` regenerated three artifacts (api-surface, export-origins and references), and each re-checks green. `check-platform-checklist`, `check-skills-token-ratchet` (`pages.md` 5669/5692) and `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` are green.

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #27059

_Keep one value on each of the two lines above, each line starting with its key.
[Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum)
item 5 says what they mean._

The changeset carries `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, the BREAKING banner, a **FROM → TO.** line and `<!-- adr-0087: registered page-slots-tabs-removed, page-slots-tabs-retired -->`. The packages bump minor: spec, platform-objects, plugin-approvals, `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and skills.

Governed surfaces (`docs/adr/**`, `skills/**`, Tier H): this PR is a draft and is not queued or armed. It needs a governed approver's review before the seat lands it.

## Human Minimum

Each item is one rule from
[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
